query:
WITH deleted AS (
               DELETE FROM photos
                WHERE id = $1 AND owner_id = $2
               RETURNING content_hash
           )
           SELECT deleted.content_hash AS "content_hash!",
                  NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                        FROM photos
                       WHERE photos.content_hash = deleted.content_hash
                         AND photos.id <> $1
                  ) AS "orphaned!"
             FROM deleted
